source_documents.title: Thermochromic aggregation-induced dual phosphorescence via temperature-dependent sp3-linked donor-acceptor electronic coupling

reference_evidence_units.quote: the lowest singlet excited state (S1) is a dark state with a strong CT character
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign a dark lowest singlet CT state in the studied five-compound series.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The dominant absorption bands are localized higher singlet states. Absorption into S2/S3 does not demonstrate higher-state emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: all TPA aggregates in THF/water (5/95, v/v) contain long-lived emissions
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5
reference_evidence_units.statement: The main text reports long-lived aggregate emission across TPA1-5.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Long-lived emission and SI traces are not interchangeable with direct measurement of triplet population.

reference_evidence_units.quote: due to the restriction of intramolecular motions and possibly newly emerged, lowest emissive states as aggregates
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' interpretation of AIE with increasing water fraction.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source associates aggregate emission with motion restriction and possibly altered lowest states.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The authors separately attribute peak shifts mainly to solvent polarity; an aggregate excited-state family is not established from brightness alone.

reference_evidence_units.quote: except for TPA2 which always generates polycrystals
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-5
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Single-crystal comparison of TPA1 and TPA3-5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Single-crystal structures were obtained for TPA1/3/4/5, not TPA2.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Do not attach a single-crystal packing structure to TPA2.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the shoulder peak intensity decays faster vs. that of the main RTP peak at room temperature
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1
reference_evidence_units.statement: The high-energy shoulder and main RTP band have different decay behavior.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Kinetic distinction alone does not decide whether the emissions arise from different adiabatic electronic states or conformers.

reference_evidence_units.quote: single-crystal purity TPA1 dissolved in PMMA were also recorded at various temperatures
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 3 wt% PMMA, delayed spectra with 1 ms delay.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Temperature-dependent dual-band behavior persists for molecularly dispersed TPA1 in PMMA.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This control argues against an exclusively aggregate-origin band, not against environmental effects altogether.

reference_evidence_units.quote: different TPA1 conformations showing different T1 states
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1
reference_evidence_units.conditions: TD-DFT minima and free energies, Figure 6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors assign dual phosphorescence to different minima on T1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The source's T1/T2 internal-conversion estimate and its stated conclusion require expert checking; no anti-Kasha label is inferred.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: The authors use motion restriction to explain AIE across TPA1-5, with solvent effects explicitly bounded.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Aggregate and rigid PMMA environments alter emission and state communication; no TPA2 single crystal is claimed.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the calculated dark singlet CT channel, not CT phosphorescence inferred solely from donor/acceptor motifs.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Temperature changes the relative emissive-state contributions in the source account.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Long-lived and temperature-dependent spectra support the source's RTP/dual-phosphorescence assignment.
